findings: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ154. The user rushes forward through a rapid multi-hit sequence, then launches a blue energy attack; additional input makes the user vanish and reappear behind the opponent for another attack. Current reference material reports 21 hits and about 40% total damage, both retained as source-reported values.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
Unsupported exact frames, hidden gates, probabilities, and patch-independent scaling are not promoted.
Documented acquisition/reward conflicts remain explicit rather than normalized without evidence.
